body.prompt: Wide two-shot inside a large Roman leather command tent at night in the dry eastern provinces, heavy leather walls, wooden tent poles, a rough wooden camp table, a low round fire pit ringed with stones in the middle of the tent glowing with orange flames: on the left the Roman emperor Marcus Aurelius at age fifty-four, lean weathered face, short curly grey-brown hair, short grey-flecked full beard, deep tired eyes, plain brown wool tunic under a deep crimson wool military cloak fastened with a round bronze brooch sitting on a plain wooden camp stool at the table in profile; on the right, standing across the table, a Roman general of about fifty, clean-shaven square jaw, short dark hair grey at the temples, a pale old scar across his left eyebrow, dented bronze muscle cuirass over a red tunic, dark red cloak, both hands resting on a dark oak travel chest bound with black iron straps, about the size of a large suitcase, its lid closed, a leather strap across the lid sealed with a lump of dark red wax on the table between them. The fire pit glows in the foreground out of focus. Both faces visible and lit. Photorealistic film still from a prestige epic historical drama, shot on ARRI Alexa with anamorphic lenses, natural skin pores and wrinkles, real wool, leather and bronze textures, volumetric firelight and thin smoke haze, deep teal-black shadows against warm orange firelight, shallow depth of field, subtle 35mm film grain, realistic human hands with five fingers. Not a painting, not an illustration. Horizontal 16:9 widescreen frame, main subject in the middle band of the frame, nothing important in the top and bottom eighth of the frame. Absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, no writing, no logos, no watermark anywhere.
